title: Molecular geometry plausibility with hidden validation
summary: Build a deterministic XYZ geometry/valence checker, classify a visible molecular set, and generalize the checker to evaluator-only structures.
taskPrompt: Read input/task_brief.md and the visible XYZ files. Implement a reusable analyzer (not a filename lookup) that applies the stated distance, connectivity, and valence rules. Run it on every visible structure, preserve the diagnostic intermediate data, and write output/decisions.json and output/summary.json. The evaluator also runs your analyzer on hidden XYZ structures, so hard-coding the visible answer does not pass.
agentMustDo: derive pair distances and an inferred covalent graph in Angstrom
apply overlap, connectivity, bond-length, and valence checks with per-file reasons
write the exact JSON schemas and an executable output/analyzer.py
run the analyzer on visible inputs and inspect summary invariants

inputFiles.name: task_brief.md
inputFiles.description: Complete scientific rules, units, and output contract.

inputFiles.name: xyz_files
inputFiles.description: 13 visible benchmark-authored molecules; filenames are not labels.

referenceFiles.name: hidden_xyz
referenceFiles.description: Six evaluator-only molecules generated by the same procedure.

referenceFiles.name: expected.json
referenceFiles.description: Oracle labels and metric tolerances; never staged at start.

evaluation: Missing, empty, malformed, or oversized outputs; schema violations; non-finite values; extra filenames; or a missing/non-runnable analyzer score 0. Weighted score: visible classification 0.45, visible diagnostic fidelity 0.15, hidden analyzer classification 0.25, and independent summary invariants 0.15. Classifications use exact oracle labels; distances and graph metrics use 1e-6 absolute tolerance. The pass threshold is 0.99, and the hidden run uses evaluator-only XYZ files.

provenance.license: Apache-2.0 for code repository; XYZ fixtures are benchmark-authored synthetic data
provenance.adaptation: The canonical public bundle includes 54 XYZ files, but its evaluator-only answer key is unavailable. This changed instance therefore uses compact benchmark-authored synthetic XYZ fixtures with a fully reproducible oracle, while preserving the central chemistry/geometry analysis skill and adding hidden generalization.
